template.name: Masimo Root Patient Monitoring Platform
template.desc: Masimo Root with Radical-7 docked, and its SedLine / O3 modules where fitted (Class I). From the CHS Ansur template “Root + Rad 7 AS-NZS 3551 EST and PVT”. Electrical safety to AS/NZS 3551:2012+A2: PE 0.2 ohm, insulation mains–PE and mains–non-earthed parts over 1 Mohm, mains to applied parts over 1 Mohm (B9.3; no limit in Ansur), the other two recorded; enclosure 100/500/500 µA, earth leakage 5000/10000 µA (B11.6; the Ansur template had 500/1000). Applied parts type BF on RA, as the Ansur records measured them (patient leakage 100/500 µA, mains on applied parts 5000 µA); the Ansur template also listed CF limits that were not applied. Patient auxiliary current has no bench step and is left out. Readings keep the Ansur limits.

steps.title: Visual inspection
steps.instructions: Inspect the monitor, cables and accessories.

items: The case, display screen, buttons, power cord, and accessories have no obvious signs of damage.
The external connecting cables are not frayed and the connector pins are not loose or bent.
The external connectors are not loose and their pins are not bent.
The safety labels and data plate are clearly legible.
The power-on test is passed. The power indicator and alarm system works correctly and the monitor starts up properly.

steps.title: Mains voltage
steps.instructions: Plug the ESA612 into the mains supply you are testing from.

steps.title: Protective earth resistance
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet. Clip the red test lead to an exposed earthed metal part, such as a rear-panel screw.

steps.title: Insulation: mains to protective earth
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet and switch the device on. Don’t touch the device during the test.

steps.title: Insulation: applied parts to protective earth
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet and switch the device on. Don’t touch the device during the test. Recorded only.

steps.title: Insulation: mains to applied parts
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet and switch the device on. Don’t touch the device during the test. Must be over 1 Mohm (AS/NZS 3551 B9.3).

steps.title: Insulation: mains to non-earth accessible conductive part
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet and switch the device on. Don’t touch the device during the test.

steps.title: Insulation: applied parts to non-earth accessible conductive part
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet and switch the device on. Don’t touch the device during the test. Recorded only.

steps.title: Enclosure leakage
steps.instructions:
Connect the red test lead to a conductive non-earthed exposed part of the monitor.
Note: only a representative sample of conductive non-earthed exposed parts needs to be tested.

steps.title: Earth leakage
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet. The device will be switched on and off between conditions. Limits: 5000 µA normal, 10000 µA neutral open (AS/NZS 3551:2012+A2 B11.6).

steps.title: Patient leakage
steps.instructions: Connect the SedLine or SpO2 patient cable (connector pins linked) to the ESA612 RA post. Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet.

steps.title: Mains on applied parts
steps.instructions: Connect the SedLine or SpO2 patient cable (connector pins linked) to the ESA612 RA post. Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet.

steps.title: SpO2
steps.instructions: Measure SpO2 on a healthy person’s finger. Check a Pleth wave and PR value are displayed, then enter the displayed SpO2.

items: A Pleth wave and PR value are displayed.

readings.label: Displayed SpO2 on a healthy finger (95–100 %)

steps.title: Temperature
steps.instructions: Only if a temperature module is fitted; otherwise mark the item N/A.

items: The temperature is within ±0.05 °C (±0.1 °F) of the reference, or the customer’s specification.

steps.title: NIBP
steps.instructions:
Only if NIBP is fitted; otherwise skip this step.
1. Set 0, 50 and 200 mmHg and enter the largest difference from the reference.
2. Run the leak test (or a manual leak test).
3. Run the overpressure test and time how long the pressure takes to be released.

steps.title: SedLine and O3
steps.instructions: Connect the SedLine and O3 simulators. Mark N/A for a module that isn’t fitted.

items: SedLine: works correctly with the simulator.
O3: works correctly with the simulator.
